objective: Prove that an ABI-extracted, domain-segregated English artifact causally supplies English capability to the exact certified LayerCake execution architecture without treating an ABI or integration failure as a failure of the already-certified LayerCake engine.

sealed_layercake_control.claim_boundary: The Phase 2 r3 result is the canonical free-neural English execution control; the Phase 8 9.91x result is a later domain-workload reproduction on the same production lineage. The earlier width-288 Phase 2 v1 checkpoint remains historical. No ABI-derived checkpoint, bridge, router, export, or package inherits any of these results.

exact_host_definition.native_positive_control: The sealed Phase 2 r3 primary checkpoint must execute through the width-768 three-block task-cake architecture and pass its bound certificates without planner, retrieval, template, stored-answer, or external next-token calls.
exact_host_definition.abi_receiver: The receiver may replace English content weights or install a bounded bridge, but must preserve the certified LayerCake architecture identifier, canonical ABI, sparse route semantics, precision contract, routing computation, runtime numerics, and output contract.
exact_host_definition.checkpoint_identity_rule: The ABI receiver is expected to have a different content checkpoint hash. It is an exact LayerCake execution host only when the execution-contract identities remain bound and the native positive control still passes independently.
exact_host_definition.forbidden_substitution: A separately reconstructed ONNX transformer, ABI-local router, or ABI-local decoding runtime is an integration prototype and cannot stand in for the exact Phase 2 r3/Phase 8 LayerCake host.

proof_owners.LAYERCAKE: The immutable native positive control and the certified host execution contracts.
proof_owners.ABI: Teacher extraction, information minimization, provenance, English-versus-domain segregation, artifact adequacy, and artifact immutability.
proof_owners.INTEGRATION: The bounded bridge and installation path connecting an immutable ABI artifact to the exact LayerCake execution host, including any added inference cost.
proof_owners.END_TO_END: The same teacher-free integrated candidate passing all quality and execution gates.

sealed_layercake_native.purpose: Detect a genuine LayerCake host or environment regression.

capability_naive_receiver.purpose: Prove the receiver does not already contain the acquired English capability.

bridge_only.purpose: Prove the bounded bridge did not relearn or conceal English.

shuffled_abi_artifact.purpose: Prove behavior depends on the artifact's learned organization rather than payload size or installation side effects.

native_payload_same_path.purpose: Prove the receiving and bridge path can carry a known-good LayerCake-native payload before blaming LayerCake for an ABI payload failure.

failure_attribution_order: An exact native LayerCake control failure is LAYERCAKE_HOST_REGRESSION.
A passing native LayerCake control followed by an extraction-gate failure is ABI_EXTRACTION_FAILURE.
A passing native control and ABI extraction followed by a same-path or integrated failure is ABI_LAYERCAKE_INTEGRATION_FAILURE.
An unexpectedly passing receiver, bridge-only, or shuffled-artifact negative control is TRANSFER_CAUSALITY_FAILURE.
Missing or non-exact controls are INCOMPLETE_ATTRIBUTION_EVIDENCE and cannot be assigned to LayerCake.
promotion_rule: Promotion requires causal transfer plus every ABI extraction and integrated gate on one immutable teacher-free artifact and exact LayerCake execution host. A LayerCake control pass cannot be borrowed as the integrated candidate's performance result, and an ABI integration failure cannot invalidate the sealed LayerCake control.
